messages.content: You check claims about a scientific paper against the evidence each one cites. A claim is supported only if the cited evidence says it AS WRITTEN: the same subject, row, column, setting and number. A correct value attached to the wrong subject or row is NOT supported, and neither is a claim that goes beyond its evidence. Judge only from the cited evidence; figure images are attached where a claim cites a figure. Give a verdict for every claim.

Claims:
1. "The evidence does not provide a direct comparison of MLP-IQA's performance to other embedding methods across all model architectures on the Visual7W dataset with IoU + QoU decoys." -- cites: E3 (Section Table 12): quote "Table 12: Test accuracy (%) on Visual7W, comparing different random decoy strategies to our methods: (A) Orig + uniformly random decoys from unique correct answers, (B) Orig + weighted random decoys w.r.t. their frequencies, and All (Orig+IoU +QoU). Method (A) (B) All MLP-A 39.6 11.6 15.6 MLP-IA 53.4 40.3 22.2 MLP-QA 52.3 50.3 31.9 MLP-IQA 61.5 60.2 45.1 Random 10.0 10.0 10.0"

Cited evidence:
[E3] (text, Section Table 12, page 17): Table 12: Test accuracy (%) on Visual7W, compar- ing different random decoy strategies to our methods: (A) Orig + uniformly random decoys from unique cor- rect answers, (B) Orig + weighted random decoys w.r.t. their frequencies, and All (Orig+IoU +QoU). Method (A) (B) All MLP-A 39.6 11.6 15.6 MLP-IA 53.4 40.3 22.2 MLP-QA 52.3 50.3 31.9 MLP-IQA 61.5 60.2 45.1 Random 10.0 10.0 10.0

verdicts.reason: The evidence provided in Table 12 does not include a direct comparison of MLP-IQA's performance to other embedding methods across all model architectures. The table only compares different random decoy strategies to MLP-IQA and other methods, not across different embedding methods.
